cards.name: Jayden Maiava
cards.portraitAlt: Pixel art portrait of Jayden Maiava in USC uniform
report: Dynamic dual-threat signal caller with exceptional arm strength and poise in pocket situations under pressure.
Stepped into the starting role after transferring from UNLV, demonstrating explosive playmaking capability downfield.

cards.name: DeShaun Foster
cards.portraitAlt: Pixel art portrait of UCLA Bruins Head Coach DeShaun Foster
report: Former UCLA star running back returned to Westwood to take over the Bruins program in their inaugural Big Ten season.
Emphasizes discipline, physicality, and maintaining Bruin culture across all phases of the rivalry.
